items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: The Blue Devils. Well, he got Walter Page on bass... I watched them come in night by night... I was the unhired regular drummer in the band until Jo got there

ctx.x: Jo Jones, you asked me about -- Jo Jones always played at home with his family, he was very happy; he had children, or that was the story -- and he always used to come in an hour and a half to two hours late nights while I was in town, which was for two or three weeks, and he would depend upon Basie -- this is before the first show -- he would depend on me being in there, being on a panic and
this was probably guitarist Claude 'Fiddler' Williams; Green joined in 1937 in New York.
and still having no money to go anywhere -- that I would be there at the beginning of the evening, so I was the unhired regular drummer in the band until Jo got there, whatever time that might be.
